reports.title: Moses McDonald
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust will carry out a full review of the Clozapine clinics across the 4 boroughs with the aim of: e Reviewing the existing operational processes, resources, management responsibilities and function of the Clozapine clinics in each borough - Croydon, Lewisham, Southwark and Lambeth e Determining the core function of these clinics e Clarifying the management roles, responsibilities and reporting structures within each clinic. e Setting core standards of practice across all 4 boroughs
promises.summary: Review Clozapine clinic processes and set standards

reports.title: Michael George
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: The Maudsley Hospital failed to address the risk of Mr George developing diabetes from the long tern use of Olanzapine and did not check his urine or blood sugar prior to 06/12/11
concerns.hazard: unmonitored diabetes risk in patients on antipsychotic medication

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of mandatory and regular glucose testing for patients receiving antipsychotic medication. The earlier report focuses on the Clozapine clinic, while the later report concerns antipsychotic use more broadly in the Maudsley Hospital wards.
links.earlier_quote: (1) The lack of mandatory and regular glucose testing while on antipsychotic medication by the Clozapine clinic.
links.later_quote: Another (0883-13) following a death from diabetic ketoacidosis, reported the lack of mandatory and regular glucose testing whilst on anti-psychotic medication.
